The chat on the island talks through the Claude Code or Codex CLI you are logged into, on your own subscription. It can also use a provider's API with your own key, or a model running on this machine.

Your Claude Code and Codex setup
The chat's CLI reads your own setup, as in your terminal: your CLAUDE.md, skills, MCP servers, hooks and allow rules. A project's settings join only in a folder you already trust in Claude Code. Cards still ask before every command or edit your rules don't allow. Off, it reads none of it. Applies to the next conversation.
Who answers Zeca's cards
Asks first: a card before every command or edit. Your policies: the policies you accepted in Approvals answer what they cover, and the rest asks. Full access: everything runs without a card, but destructive commands and what a policy denies or asks first; once a conversation reads from outside (a web page, a fetch, an MCP tool), its cards ask again. Every answer is in the audit log. Holds at once.
